title: A Comparison Pogorelov Estimate for Graphical $σ_k$-Curvature Equations
summary: We establish comparison Pogorelov estimates for admissible solutions of graphical $σ_k$-curvature equations, extending the two-surface estimate of Qiu and Yan for the graphical scalar curvature equation. The comparison graph is assumed only to be $k$-admissible, with a bounded slope and a positive interior gap that vanishes on the boundary. The estimates cover $2\le k<n$ for prescribed data $f(x,u)$, and $n/2\le k<n$ for general data $f(x,u,Du)$.
